showcase.title: Our designs
showcase.intro: Every look we make, shown on invented examples. Tap one to open it, then try other colours and opening screens. The names, places and numbers are made up and the pictures are illustrations.
showcase.phoneTitle: A live example of the {name} design
showcase.example: Example sites use invented names and illustrated pictures.

classic.feel: A full-screen cover photo and a framed invitation card, then the day, the venues and a swipeable gallery.
classic.goodFor: Families who want the traditional look, done well.
classic.b1: A framed invitation card with the border you choose
classic.b2: A timeline of the day with an icon for each step

editorial.feel: A magazine spread: the date in huge numerals, oval portraits and a dated love story.
editorial.goodFor: Couples with a story to tell and good portraits.
editorial.b1: A split cover with the date in large numerals
editorial.b3: Dated story chapters and a mosaic gallery

reel.feel: A film: opening credits, the couple as the stars and the day told as scenes.
reel.goodFor: Couples who love photography and video.
reel.b1: A letterboxed cover with opening credits
reel.b3: A film-strip gallery and end credits

noir.feel: Black tie: a gold crest monogram, gold-foil names and a framed gallery wall.
noir.b1: A gold crest made from your initials

arches.feel: Ivory and gold, with the cover photo in an arched window.
arches.b1: The cover photo in an arched window
arches.b3: An arcade of events and an arch-cropped photo strip

stories.feel: Tap through it like stories on a phone, one full-screen card at a time.
stories.goodFor: Younger couples and guests who live on their phones.
stories.b1: One card at a time, with progress bars
stories.b2: Tap or use the arrow keys to move on
stories.b3: Cover, invitation, the day, photos and RSVP

flatlay.feel: A stationery suite on linen: a sealed envelope, then cards that stack as you scroll.
flatlay.goodFor: Couples who care about paper and detail.
flatlay.b1: A sealed envelope that opens onto the cards
flatlay.b2: Invitation, schedule, details and RSVP cards stacking up
flatlay.b3: Photo prints fanned across the page

kaba.feel: A groom's velvet kaba: deep velvet with gold-thread embroidery that stitches itself in.
kaba.b1: Embroidery that stitches itself in as you scroll
kaba.b2: A stitched timeline that marks the Mels

brana.feel: An illuminated Ge'ez manuscript on parchment, with the names in red.
brana.goodFor: Couples who love Ethiopian manuscripts and Amharic.
brana.b1: Harag headpieces and names in red
brana.b3: The day as a canon table, and a colophon at the end

slate.feel: Clean and modern: a full photo cover, script accents over serif headings and cards for the day.
slate.goodFor: Modern weddings, and destination and diaspora couples.
slate.b2: The day as cards down a rail

commencement.feel: Light and modern, with the class year in huge outline numerals behind the names.
commencement.goodFor: One graduate, or several finishing together.
commencement.b1: A diploma-style card for each graduate
commencement.b2: Photos in groups you name, like “The two of us”
commencement.b3: The class year across the cover

tassel.feel: A deep cover in your first colour, with a laurel wreath of initials hung on a gold cord.
tassel.goodFor: Families who want a formal, gown-and-gold look.
tassel.b1: A tassel that swings once as the page opens
tassel.b3: The invitation on a bordered card

confetti.feel: The name set huge in a page of confetti in your three colours.
confetti.goodFor: Children's and young people's birthdays, and happy parties.
confetti.b1: Confetti that settles once as the page opens
confetti.b2: Their own line on a ribbon, like “Turns 7”

milestone.feel: Elegant, for the big numbers: the age in large gold foil on a dark cover.
milestone.b2: The age is read from their own line
milestone.b3: Shows the name alone when there is no age

shema.feel: A christening in white: a length of woven shema cloth with your border down both edges.
shema.b1: Christening name and godparents on the child's card
shema.b3: A cross only if the family chooses one
